name: Vernal-Bajada

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: Nomad fleets riding the thermal belts, at war over every kilowatt of harvest.

description: Water rules this world utterly, kilometers deep over drowned continents. Swells march in orderly regiments until they shatter against massive canyon systems, and the spray smells of minerals and cold salt.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Their beacons answer incoming ships in a hundred borrowed languages.
Core samples from the deep crust contain isotopes with no known decay chain. The samples are stored off-world now, and studied reluctantly.
There is money in rare flora here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
